name: literature_medium_suite
purpose: First medium-scale matrix after integrating relation-aware attention, dual-stream, structural-generalization, and interpretability literature.

model_scale.target_class: small-medium local run; scale to 10M-30M after runner validation

go_criteria: selective gains on controlled structural splits
phase/residual geometry is cleaner for structural labels
ablation or patching shows causal structural-stream involvement
gains survive ALiBi, DeBERTa-lite, iso-param, and relational-stream-lite baselines
stop_or_reframe_criteria: relative-bias or DeBERTa-lite baselines match all gains
phase-only, inert, and full variants remain indistinguishable
stream interventions show no causal effect
